title: Raw Salmon Cream Cheese Maki
description: Raw salmon, chilled cream cheese and crisp cucumber wrapped with rice and nori.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Cut chilled raw-consumption salmon, cream cheese and cucumber into long strips.
Spread prepared rice across nori, leaving the far border clear. Align salmon, cream cheese and cucumber lengthwise.
If desired, apply just a few drops of lemon to the salmon.
Roll firmly and cut into eight slices, wiping the knife to avoid smearing the cream cheese.
notes: Unlike the existing Salmon Cream Cheese Roll, this version uses raw salmon.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
